goal: Learn relational variable identity directly from paired, raw-bit encodings of two graph slots, without engineered equals/match bits or oracle answer as a feature; test zero-shot composition at longer depth and unseen role names and graph topology.
scope: Public source-only synthetic development, Wingless and Yggdrasil isolated. F121 draft ancestry; never native scientific original, first-use admission, accepted scientific outcome or autonomous promotion.
source: Both SHA-identified GenEnv candidate vectors per lane from the existing F118/F120 advisory contract. Vector may control decoy count, but must not become a model input.

arms.A: Trainable diagonal bilinear relation classifier over TWO unlabelled 16-bit variable-token encodings. Pairwise bit interactions occur inside the learned model; they are NOT equality-oracle flags. 17 parameters including bias.
arms.B: Trainable 12-hidden-unit tanh multilayer perceptron over the concatenation of TWO 16-bit variable-token encodings, with at most 409 parameters. No comparator bit or engineered equality feature.
arms.CTRL_DEPTH2: Fixed maximum-two-hop raw binding path, no learned parameters.
arms.CTRL_ROLE: Fixed role-only path classifier, ignores variable slots.
arms.CTRL_EXACT_SYMBOLIC: Full raw variable-binding equality oracle, always reported as ceiling, never provided to the model.

observations.encoding: Use the same deterministic 16-bit salted SHA-256 projection of an integer variable symbol across each paired input graph. Salt is per graph; hidden from model. Fail closed on any within-graph token-code collision. Model only sees bit arrays of both symbols, never labels, graph seed, source ID, candidate ID, exact-equivalence flags or solution truth.
observations.supervision: Training-only paired intervention localizes the changed path junction by graph-difference, not by evaluating variable equality. Extract one unaltered positive path junction and the paired changed negative path junction, with graph-pair truth as training labels. For evaluation require all path junctions to pass model relational scoring.
observations.anti_shortcut: Positive and negative have exactly identical topology, role sequence and global variable-slot multiset; negative swaps a target-path slot with a role-incompatible decoy. Source-family roles are disjoint from confirmation-family roles; confirmation uses new nodes, new seeds, new variable tokens and extra side branches.
observations.no_future_leak: TRAIN is the only cohort used for parameter update and model selection. Confirmation is never used for tuning, threshold selection, or design changes.
observations.models: Predict pair compatibility at threshold 0.5, graph valid only if every selected path junction passes. Prediction never calls an equality oracle.

cohorts.train_only_selection: highest total paired correctness across both training environments; tie to A

metrics.primary: paired correct graphs on frozen disjoint CONFIRM, plus balanced binary accuracy; disclose each arm, both source environments, frozen controls, source identities and hashes
metrics.genuine_learner: Require actual finite nonzero parameter updates, no fixed equality sensor as model input and no heldout-driven selection.
metrics.success_rule: Report raw-transfer paired accuracy and parity/gap against exact symbolic oracle. Do not claim scientific improvement if fixed equality control is equally strong or stronger.
metrics.negative: Preserve negative or non-transfer as a valid bounded result, not a workflow failure.
metrics.scientific_acceptance: Not authorized, regardless of transfer score.

qualification: Frozen source identity first; focused counterfactual, input-leakage, train/confirmation separation, both arms and exact control tests; existing Ubuntu and Windows development CI and full Go regression at final head. Draft PR, no merge or promotion.
